paragraphs: R' Shaul of Naveh. In R' Shimon's name: Midrash Kohelet, on ‘Besides being wise, Kohelet,’ etc. Mattenot Kehunah explains this as a town's name. Behar, chapter 34: Sheila of Naveha. Midrash Ruth, on ‘Her mother-in-law said to her,’ and Jerusalem Talmud, Shabbat 2:5: R' Sheila of דינוה [provisionally Naveh]; the rabbis of Caesarea spoke in his name. Perhaps all are one.
